response.justification: Bogdan is a seasoned generalist engineer with 13+ years of experience, strong software craftsmanship (TDD, CI/CD, mentoring, public speaking) and proven high-throughput distributed systems work at Sociomantic. However, the role's core requirement — hands-on senior C++/STL development — is barely represented: roughly six months of C/C++ work at National Instruments in 2014-2015 and a university thesis project, with all recent work in TypeScript/Node.js and DLang. There is no evidence of IEC 62443/SDL security practice, MQTT/industrial protocols, industrial automation domain, or Azure. The transferable skills (concurrency, low-latency services, event-driven architecture, message-driven design) are real but would require a substantial ramp-up in both language and domain, which is a poor match for a mid-senior role expected to architect and mentor in C++.
strengths: Deep experience with low-latency, high-throughput distributed and event-driven systems
Strong engineering practices: TDD, CI/CD, testing tooling, mentoring and workshops
Long track record of quickly adopting new languages, platforms and stacks
concerns: C++/STL experience is minimal and over a decade out of date
No industrial automation, IoT, MQTT or IEC 62443/SDL security background
Recent career is web/full-stack focused; no Azure or industrial protocol exposure

key_factors.factor: Industrial automation & IEC 62443 security domain gap
